none: PAS FindID 972237: Roman Coin: Nummus of the House of Constantine
contea di ritrovamento: Lincolnshire (Inghilterra e Galles)

Copper alloy coin. Nummus of the House of Constantine (306-361), Trier mint Gloria Exercitus issue of 335-341, Reece period 17. Obverse description: Bust draped and diademed right. Reverse description: Two soldiers with one standard between them; X on a square vexillum. Reverse inscription: [GLOR] IA EX [ERCITVS]. In exergue: TRP. Diameter: 14.6mm, Weight: 1.02gms, die axis: 6
